statements: No secondary legislation can be identified as made under section 117 of the Education (Scotland) Act 1962, so the answer is an empty list and no instrument should be listed as made under that section.
Section 117 of the Education (Scotland) Act 1962 is repealed and no text of it survives in the current version of the Act, so nothing can be stated about the power it conferred.

The Scottish education instruments that look like candidates were each made under a different section of the 1962 Act, such as section 116 for the Independent Schools Tribunal (Scotland) Rules 1977 and sections 75 and 76 for the Students' Allowances (Scotland) Regulations 1962.
The Education (Scotland) Act 1962 is a different statute from the Education (Scotland) Act 1980 that superseded it, and an answer about section 117 of the 1980 Act does not answer this question.
